query: What per‑class sample‑size and power calculations support the field campaign to meet user/producer accuracy targets (e.g., ±5% at 95% CI), and do ~1,000 points suffice for rare/mosaic classes?

response.query: What per‑class sample‑size and power calculations support the field campaign to meet user/producer accuracy targets (e.g., ±5% at 95% CI), and do ~1,000 points suffice for rare/mosaic classes?
response.answer: To meet ±5% accuracy targets at 95% CI, per-class sample sizes and power calculations typically require at least 1,000 points for common classes, but rare/mosaic classes may need more due to their variability. Generally, 1,000 points may suffice for rare classes if they are well-distributed.
